questions.stem: Through which structures does most water vapour leave the leaf during transpiration?

options.text: Through the cell walls of the epidermis
Through the stomata on the leaf surface
Through the waxy cuticle on the upper surface
Through the xylem vessels in the veins

questions.explanation: About 90% of water vapour is lost through the stomata. Only about 10% is lost through the cuticle. Plants can partly control water loss by opening and closing their stomata using guard cells.
